t: This widget renames the $(l:tools/drone)Drone/$, as if you had $(thing)right-clicked/$ it with a $(item)Name Tag/$. The name is entered in the attached $(l:programming/text)Text/$ widget.
这个组件会为$(l:tools/drone)雄蜂/$重命名，就像你用$(item)命名牌/$$(thing)右击/$它一样。名称需在附加的$(l:programming/text)文本/$组件中输入。

You can also insert the value of a $(l:programming/variables)variable/$, by including $(thing)${<var_name>}/$ in the text, e.g.$(p)  $(formula)Counter: ${counter}/$$(p)would expand to $(thing)Counter: 1, 2, 3/$ if the $(thing)counter/$ variable was set to $(thing)x=1,y=2,z=3/$. $(l:programming/variables#special)Special/$ and $(l:programming/variables#global)Global variables/$ can also be used here.

你也可以插入$(l:programming/variables)变量/$的值，只需在文本中包含$(thing)${<var_name>}/$，例如：$(p)  $(formula)计数器：${counter}/$$(p)会展开为$(thing)计数器：1、2、3/$，前提是$(thing)counter/$变量被设置为$(thing)x=1,y=2,z=3/$。这里也可以使用$(l:programming/variables#special)特殊/$和$(l:programming/variables#global)全局变量/$。
